name: omp.terminal
description: The built-in terminal: a work-panel tab this application draws itself, and the rules that teach the agent to work in the terminal a workspace has open.

omp.name: Terminal
omp.description: A terminal in the work panel, one shell per workspace. The shell is this application's own; the plugin declares where the tab sits and carries the rules that teach the agent to use it.

en.name: Terminal
en.description: A terminal in the work panel, one shell per workspace. The shell is this application's own; the plugin declares where the tab sits and carries the rules that teach the agent to use it.

zh.name: 终端
zh.description: 工作面板里的终端，每个工作区一个 shell。shell 由应用自己托管；本插件声明这个页签的位置，并随包带上教 agent 使用它的规则。
